title: Aceitação de jogos desenvolvidor com AI
author: Minimum_Lock_1906
selftext:
Pessoal, boa noite

estou desenvolvendo um jogo de gerenciamento esportivo baseado em texto utilizando AI para praticamente todo o processo, inclusive como uma forma de experimento individual sobre o potencial da AI

existem casos de jogos de sucesso sendo desenvolvidos majoritariamente com AI?

qual a aceitação do público com esse tipo de jogo?

pergunto pois vi em outros fóruns algumas negativas com relação ao desenvolvimento de games com AI

se eu lançar esse jogo, o uso de AI seria um detrator para vendas?

comments.author: Trashy_io
comments.body: There was a good post made a couple days ago ill find it and link it

replies.author: Minimum_Lock_1906
replies.body: Obrigado meu caro, se encontrar o link irei agradecer bastante!!!

replies.author: Trashy_io
replies.body:
I couldn't find the exact post it was a more lengthier one with a lot of good examples i'm not sure if it was posted to this sub might have been another gaming sub I thought I saved it but unfortunately not :/ but the one I linked has the overall point I hope it helps and ill keep
looking bc it was a great post! And np!

comments.author: Am_Biyori
comments.body: I'd like to think if a game is done well no will know or care if AI was used. I maybe naive, but before sweating the AI question, think about getting it play-tested and getting a demo together. This will tell you a lot more about what AI can do than posters or Reddit.

replies.author: Minimum_Lock_1906
replies.body: Tenho a mesma visão que você, mas gostaria de saber como o público enxerga isso para pensar se direciono esse desenvolvimento para interesse próprio apenas ou para disponibilizar para externos

comments.author: BemaniAK
comments.body:
AI generated assets like images or sounds often stick out like a sore thumb, like obvious quality or consistency issues.
AI assisted code on the other hand is indistinguishable as long as you pilot it properly.

comments.author: MongooseEmpty4801
comments.body: Any successful AI games? Not yet, and likely not any time soon. AI allows low effort development, and that often bleeds over into gameplay.

comments.author: CaptainAlexWest
comments.body: We are hated. We are the punk rock band, and everyone hates. If your game isn't buggy, broken, and doesn't look like a cheap iPhone game, people don't care. I go extra and fix all the bugs. We are early but the windows is closing fast. claude mythos is about to fail hard or shredded everything up.

comments.author: roguelikeforever
comments.body: I mean all games are going to be made with AI sooner or later so I don’t know why it would be a problem.  That said, There will still be good games and bad games just like now.  It will come down to the same thing it always has: the talent of the people creating it.
